payload.title: An empty repository becomes a werk project whose checks all run green from make targets
The werk command line finds its verbs by registration and prints them in its help
Tests run werk against a fresh temporary project with a scripted fake agent, never the real one
An agent proposes, links, accepts and discards cards through the command line, and the map folds from an append-only log
A card becomes decided only when the contract check finds who, a basis, an option and a kill criterion
A change to a card is staged as a tagged proposal and amends a decided card on accept
A reopen or an amend marks the next hop stale, a postponement pauses everything downstream, and each mark carries its trace
A card and its subtree can be removed and restored exactly as they were
An agent searches decided cards by their words and finds open work that is not waiting
An agent writes notes on a card's thread and reads them in an inbox, and a corrected ghost keeps its thread
The printed card shows its rollup, links with reasons, marks, and the words of its options, excerpts and sources
An agent quotes a conversation verbatim and gets an excerpt ghost with an exact pointer, or a refusal that says why
werk serve holds a project's map behind a lock and a token, and signals every log change on a live channel
A browser opens werk's React client served from the same process, with hot reload in dev and a browser test harness
Card text renders Markdown with live card links and boxed, highlighted code
A card page shows the card as a hero box with its proof, link lists, marks and a grid of sub-card tiles
The header shows breadcrumbs, view tabs, counts and a search box, and the home view shows requirements and build rules side by side
A person accepts a proposal with a check mark, sees an edit as a diff, and removes a card with a confirmed cross
Every agent werk starts with write access gets the werk agent instructions, their subagents and the build-rule titles
A person sends a message with the open card as context and watches the agent's reply stream in while the map redraws
A conversation survives a server restart with its model and context fill, and a crashed agent shows its whole error
A tool call Claude Code cannot resolve, and a question from the agent, are answered in the chat pane
A person keeps several conversations in tabs, each with its own agent and home card, and sees which one needs them
The composer offers command and card menus, and a pasted screenshot uploads at once and reaches the agent as a path
One werk server holds many projects, and a switcher in the header opens any of them while agents keep running
The ticket-check operation checks a folder of hand-written tickets and prints one line per failure
Ticket state lives in an append-only board log, and an agent lists, moves, archives and restores tickets
A plan turns a decided subtree into one spec and checked tickets, and proposes every writer answer as a ghost
A second plan extends the subtree's spec and open tickets, and a changed cited card blocks the open tickets that cite it
werk build runs fresh builder passes on one ticket in its own worktree until its checks pass or the cap stops it
A green pass is graded against every card it rests on and reviewed in five quality areas by read-only agents
A pass that hits a decision no card makes becomes a decision pass that proposes a card and builds on it
An overseer inside each build pass cancels a stalled agent, answers its permission asks, and catches a loop
A held-out set of steps the builder never sees is written, bound to browser tests and run on the run's tree, and G2 waits for it
werk run builds a subtree's tickets and merges each one onto the main line only after the checks pass on the merged tree
Up to three tickets that touch no common module build at once, and a merge conflict is resolved on the ticket's own branch
After each merge the held-out set runs beside the merge queue, and a red step files one follow-up per source ticket
The board shows every ticket in five columns, with a live dot while a session runs and a drawer with its slice and log
A person reorders ready tickets, triggers one early inside a run, and archives a ticket with a confirmation that ends its build
One Build press on a decided card plans its subtree and runs it as one detached process, shown on a plan card that can resume or restart it
werk builds into one executable per platform that serves its client and prompts from inside itself
Every push to the main line runs all checks on a clean machine, then builds and starts the executable once
